name: Hyper-CVAD (Part A): Cyclophosphamide + Vincristine + DOXOrubicin + Dexamethasone
supportiveCare: Mandatory TLS prophylaxis with hydration and rasburicase or allopurinol
PJP and fungal prophylaxis with posaconazole / voriconazole
Filgrastim (G-CSF) 5 mcg/kg/day SC starting Day 5 until ANC recovery
monitoring: CBC with diff daily during inpatient admission
CMP, electrolytes, uric acid, phosphorus q12-24h during induction

drugs.name: Cyclophosphamide
drugs.notes: Cyclophosphamide 300 mg/m2 IV q12h x 6 doses (Days 1-3) with continuous Mesna.

drugs.name: vinCRIStine
drugs.notes: vinCRIStine 2 mg flat IV push on Days 4 and 11. Fatal if given intrathecally. IV only.

drugs.name: DOXOrubicin
drugs.notes: DOXOrubicin 50 mg/m2 IV over 24 hours on Day 4.

drugs.name: Dexamethasone
drugs.notes: Dexamethasone 40 mg PO or IV once daily on Days 1-4 and Days 11-14.
